name: get_weather
description: Retrieves current weather or forecast for a specific location.

location.description: The city and state/country, e.g., 'San Francisco, CA' or 'local'

name: web_search
description: Performs a live internet search to retrieve snippets for current events or facts.

name: network_scan
description: Scans the local network (LAN) to identify connected devices and open ports.

name: play_music
description: Starts or resumes Spotify music without pausing music that is already playing.

name: pause_music
description: Pauses Spotify music without resuming music that is already paused.

name: lower_music_volume
description: Lowers the current Spotify device volume by a percentage step.

percent.description: How many percentage points to lower the volume by, e.g. 20. Defaults to 10.

name: raise_music_volume
description: Raises the current Spotify device volume by a percentage step.

percent.description: How many percentage points to raise the volume by, e.g. 10. Defaults to 10.

name: get_current_music
description: Reports the Spotify song and artist currently playing, or says that no music is playing.
